cases.topology: loopback mock upstream -> generic openai-compatibility gateway -> streaming client

cases.observation: The first upstream attempt received a synthetic HTTP 429. The request recovered with exactly one additional upstream attempt and returned HTTP 200; no unbounded retry was observed.
cases.limitation: This proves a bounded pre-output provider recovery in this synthetic lane; it does not qualify retry after an ambiguous external effect.

cases.observation: After the first selected credential returned 429, the second attempt used the other credential while preserving the same provider/model and completed successfully.
cases.limitation: No durable client-visible structured attempt lineage is exported yet.

cases.observation: The independent verifier could observe the two credential attempts from the mock upstream and masked gateway log, but the normal gateway response did not expose a structured ordered attempt receipt.

invalidatedControl.reason: The first version assumed YAML key order determined fill-first selection; the gateway selected dummy-b first and succeeded, so failover was never exercised.

interpretation: Core streaming-tool reconstruction and bounded same-provider credential failover are independently observed. The remaining material gap is not basic routing but structured attempt lineage and capability-specific protocol choice.
